invariants.name: unparented_node_count_maintenance
invariants.description: During the iteration over edges, the counter z maintains the number of vertices that have not yet appeared as the tail (v) of any processed directed edge, i.e., the number of vertices with currently observed in-degree zero.

properties.update_rule: when an edge (u,v) is encountered and v still has no incoming edge recorded (noparent[v] is true), decrement z by 1 and mark noparent[v] as false

invariants.name: minimum_operations_formula
invariants.description: The minimum number of operations required to turn the directed tree into a rooted tree is exactly (number of vertices with in-degree zero) minus one.

properties.operations: c minus 1, where c is the count of vertices with zero in-degree
